generation: KiCad 10.0.6 native GLB export of current V41 board, external copper, saved zones, pads, vias, silkscreen and solder mask. Only component model assignments added to a separate visualization copy. Native triangles grouped by reference and material for browser efficiency.
frame: Absolute metres; KiCad X -> X, board height Z -> Y, KiCad Y -> Z. Origin 0x0 mm. No board recentering in exported file; viewer applies shared assembly normalization once.

limitations: Generic connector, jack, LED and DPY bodies illustrate placement, not mating or installed heights.
Harwin JP1 uses a nominal standard 2-pin header body.
No separate loose shunt body is shown.
Source native routing and fabrication readiness are not altered by this visualization.

The native 3D exporter reports one self-interference warning for a copper wire at X105.790898..107.008146 / Y86.001335..86.832516 mm. A 0.001 mm tolerance retry gives the same warning. GLB is an assembly illustration; the separate exact native routing viewer and native PCB remain authoritative for copper inspection.
Other assembly boards use the prior simplified source-backed reference bodies; mating tolerances and installed heights are unverified.
